newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Feb 28.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices were lower with few enquiries and many shipowners stayed sidelined, traders said on Friday. Recent crude falls reinforced shipowners' belief that prices could continue to come down. A major sold 380-cst at $96 per tonne. "The market is so bad that prices might go down further as shipowners expected," said one trader.
